review_RobotAction_class: review the RobotAction class that handles which robot instance an action is applied to in Habitat rearrange tasks
summarize_robot_mgr_property: summarize the _robot_mgr property that returns the underlying robot manager for the robot instance the action is attached to
review_cur_robot_property: review the cur_robot property that returns the robot instance for this action from the robot manager
summarize_cur_grasp_mgr_property: summarize the cur_grasp_mgr property that returns the grasp manager for the robot instance for this action
review_action_arg_prefix_property: review the _action_arg_prefix property that returns the action prefix for sensor and action names when there are multiple agents
